ratings.reason: Turns scattered yield and cost facts into one ranked plan with a stopping gate, now steering waves. It rests on one wave's yields and a price table measured to be about twice too high.
Built, tested and in live use for twelve leases, but unmerged on main and with no measured avoided duplicate. Unranked until its effect can be shown.

Merged, tested, and its refusal and re-queue behaviour was observed on hosted runs before the queue backlog cleared. Concurrency gain over the serial runner is shown by one probe, not a matched benchmark.
Replaces a lumped estimate with per-model pricing validated against the CLI's own totals and shows Bentham's table about twice too high. Unmerged, and prices remain estimates.
A sound design with a passing live smoke test, but unmerged, unused by any live job, and the real-account backend has never run. Unranked until bytes are verified in the store.
Offline tests and sourced billing facts, but no real model call has ever run through it. Unranked until a measured batch exists.

Reproducible comparison against two real baselines, corrected after an independent check. Its value is calibration and citation; the baselines share the project's own source notes and the second lacks order numbers.

Every route was opened rather than assumed, with robots and terms findings and a hashed smoke item, and it redirected jobs away from two blocked hosts. Whether the routes convert to held sources is not yet shown.
A working multi-reader pipeline that shows the GPO layer never writes fraction glyphs, but with no reference text no accuracy or adoption conclusion is possible.
Exact rebuild gate plus blind adjudication gives a credible first comparison and a cheap complementary reviewer, but eight plants support no rate.
A built, tested interface for the one step no machine can do, but no human has certified through it. Unranked until a certifier pilot yields results.
A proposal with a dry-run build and no publication. No outcome can be graded.
A clean, measured trial that also corrected the hosting assumption, but it demonstrates only that a small build works; no adoption benefit is shown.
A complete, zero-error-rate run over a real finding aid that can date later events. Entries are leads to pages not yet held and no claim yet uses them.
Only a smoke run exists. Unranked until the full multi-edition series is measured.
A smoke sample of about half a percent of the file; no full-run measurement. Unranked until the full run's controls and counts exist.
Answers the project's central question with a reproducible, categorized count and names its own limits and next unlocks. It is a measure over provisional records, not a rate.
Supplies the missing later-instrument texts with measured recall and no false locations in thousands of planted negatives. A lead supplier whose effect on ready dossiers is still being wired.
Decides a large share of the undecided pool as leads at low measured error and with strong control catches. No lead has yet been adopted as a status or turned into a filed dossier.
A large proved library with a clear kernel, but no producer yet imports a lemma and no saving in tokens or time per order is measured.
Reproduces the tracker's own counts at every generation and credits changes fairly smoothly. The credit weights are judgment, so it describes progress rather than forecasting it.
Retained 3,060 sources aimed at a large real blocker, but 812 recorded hashes no longer matched and it grew the repository faster than its bytes could be stored, so it was paused.
Found official printings for thousands of orders with zero accepted negatives among 6,834 and two measured rule repairs. Counting them still needs the owner and a downstream rule.

The largest measured conversion of the original-text blocker: thousands of orders gained a page-checked printing or replica, with adjudicated failures recorded, and the tracker's no-official-source count fell from 4,787 to 1,751.
A measured, control-checked way to turn transcription-only orders into official-printing candidates. Hundreds of strong finds, but conversion to counted originals waits on a rule.
Fetched all notices and most targeted sections at no model cost and fed a 41-claim wave. The remaining current-law blockers are mostly sections it could not parse or find.
Identified most of its unknowns and surfaced 30 held orders missing from the census. Most identifications lack text and rest on secondary sources.
Honestly measures what the night wave's products change (nothing for ready counts) and wires the usable ones. The finding is itself a limit on how much those products add.
A navigation list with a reproducible count but no acquisition yet carried out from it. Unranked until the collection yields images that convert orders.
The largest reviewed filing wave to date: 545 claims with every planted control caught, and the blocked remainder named the missing sources that later jobs target.
Merged the repairs, measured the YES stratum's yield and the reviewers' control catch, and produced a first estimate. The estimate rests on 19 respondents and the YES probe missed one batch control.
A sampled, replicated cost projection that redirected effort from agent waves to source acquisition, certification and claim-kit gaps. Cost basis is list-price and partly overstated.
Cheap, bounded repairs that fixed freshness and readiness bookkeeping and set the headline estimand. Its figures are provenance repairs and measurements, not new dossiers.
